name: qutools
description: qutools develops and manufactures precision instruments for quantum physics experiments, including entangled photon sources, quantum random number generators, and quantum cryptography systems. Founded by quantum physicists from Ludwig-Maximilians-University Munich, the company serves both scientific research and industrial applications in quantum information.
